name: Marken
description: One doctype for every brand shown on the site — the brand-story pages (/ueber-uns/marken/[title] + its en/fr/it siblings), the brand-listing grid, the brand-detail Open Graph/JSON-LD, and the commercial product-listing page's brand header (/produkte/[title]). Reverse-engineered from every place the Next.js frontend reads a `marke.*` field (src/components/MarkenItems/markenitems.js, src/components/ProdukteItem/produkteitem.js, src/lib/api/fetchMarkenData.js, src/lib/seo/brandSchema.js, src/app/[locale]/{ueber-uns/marken,about-us/brands,a-propos/marques,chi-siamo/marche}/[title]/page.js). `Produkte.marken` links to this doctype by its `name1`-derived slug context — see frappe-integration/README.md.

fields.label: Markenname
fields.description: The ONLY name field the frontend actually reads (marke.name1) — used for the <h1>, the URL slug (generateSlug(name1)), breadcrumbs, JSON-LD Brand.name, generateStaticParams, and the sitemap. Do not confuse with the doc's own Frappe `name` (autoname hash) — a few frontend files (src/app/[locale]/ueber-uns/marken/[title]/page.js ~line 97/114) read `marke.name` for a description/alt fallback, which is a pre-existing frontend bug reading the docname instead of name1, not a field this doctype needs to provide.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Every brand-facing page (story page, listing grid, product-listing header) filters/404s on `=== "Aktiv"` client-side — the API does not filter this itself, matching how Produkte's raw endpoints work.

fields.label: Hat Produkte
fields.description: Gates whether the brand appears on the /produkte overview (fetchMarkenWithProducts in fetchMarkenData.js checks `es_gibt_produkte === 1 || "1"`). Not related to whether any `Produkte` records actually link here — purely an editorial toggle.

fields.label: Offizielle Website
fields.description: Brand's own official site. brandSchema.js normalizes this down to its origin for the JSON-LD Brand.sameAs link; the story page also links out to it directly.

fields.label: Logo
fields.description: Used two places: the brand-listing grid (fetchMarkenData default export returns it as `images`) and the JSON-LD Brand.logo (brandSchema.js) — NOT the hero/gallery image on the story page, that's bild_anhagen below.

fields.label: Bildergalerie
fields.description: Hero image + gallery slider on the brand-story page, and the Open Graph/Twitter/JSON-LD primary image (always reads row [0]). Row order = display order. Spelled with ONE 'n' (bild_anhagen) — this is deliberately the opposite spelling from Produkte's `bild_anhangen` (two n's); each doctype is internally consistent, just don't cross-copy the fieldname between them.

fields.label: Produkte (Sortiments-Beschreibung)
fields.description: Not a list of actual Produkte records — free text describing the brand's product range, shown on the story page's "Produkte" block and used as the brand-detail meta-description fallback (`marke?.produkte`).
